description: Every approval decision with its gate trace (spec §6.13, §12.5). Auto-approve stays off in config until Phase 5.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', coalesce(r.finished_at, r.started_at)) AS "time", d.decision AS "metric", count(*)::float8 AS "decisions"
FROM approval_decisions d JOIN reviews r ON r.id = d.review_id
WHERE r.caller = 'production' AND $__timeFilter(coalesce(r.finished_at, r.started_at)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Stage 1 reasons, the merge safety score and Stage 2's decision. The PR link opens GitHub, which enforces repo access.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(r.finished_at, r.started_at) AS "When", r.repo AS "Repo", r.pr_number AS "PR",
  'https://github.com/' || r.repo || '/pull/' || r.pr_number AS "Link", left(r.head_sha, 12) AS "Head",
  d.decision AS "Decision", (d.stage1->>'eligible')::boolean AS "Stage 1 eligible",
  (SELECT string_agg(x, ', ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(d.stage1->'reasons', '[]'::jsonb)) x) AS "Stage 1 reasons",
  (d.stage1->'merge_safety'->>'score')::float8 AS "Merge safety",
  d.stage2->>'decision' AS "Stage 2", (d.stage2->'categorization'->>'review_confidence')::float8 AS "Review confidence"
FROM approval_decisions d JOIN reviews r ON r.id = d.review_id
WHERE r.caller = 'production' AND $__timeFilter(coalesce(r.finished_at, r.started_at))
ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Decisions

panels.description: Merged PRs whose head the gates approved, later reverted or linked to an incident (spec §12.5).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.merged_at AS "Merged", o.repo AS "Repo", o.pr_number AS "PR", 'https://github.com/' || o.repo || '/pull/' || o.pr_number AS "Link",
  left(o.head_sha, 12) AS "Head", o.reverted AS "Reverted", o.incident AS "Incident"
FROM merge_outcomes o WHERE o.auto_approved AND (o.reverted OR o.incident) AND $__timeFilter(o.merged_at) ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Auto-approved merges that failed

panels.description: Each repo's auto-approve kill switch as its latest production decision saw it: off globally, off for the repo, or on.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.repo) r.repo AS "Repo",
  CASE WHEN d.stage1->'reasons' ? 'auto_approve_disabled_globally' THEN 'off (global)'
       WHEN d.stage1->'reasons' ? 'auto_approve_disabled_for_repo' THEN 'off (repo)' ELSE 'on' END AS "Auto-approve",
  coalesce(r.finished_at, r.started_at) AS "As of"
FROM approval_decisions d JOIN reviews r ON r.id = d.review_id
WHERE r.caller = 'production'
ORDER BY r.repo, r.id DESC
